name: Nyesa Valores Corporacion, S.A.
summary: Nyesa Valores Corporación, S.A. develops real estate projects in Spain and internationally. It develops residential, industrial, offices, hotels, and commercial spaces. The company also engages in the urban development activities and acquisition of real estate assets. Nyesa Valores Corporación, S.A. was founded in 1950 and is based in Madrid, Spain.
